rca_of_issue: One bug found & fixed in this iteration. RCA: src/acoustic.ts:73 useEffect(() => () => { try { recorder.stop(); } catch {} }, []) — the sync try/catch does NOT catch async Promise rejections from expo-audio's recorder.stop(). When user entered Angel Mode without tapping the Akustický Strážca toggle (so recorder was never initialized) and then exited (angel-toggle-back or navigated away), the unmount ran stop() on an uninitialized MediaRecorder, which rejected with 'Cannot start an audio recording without initializing a MediaRecorder' — surfaced as a full red-screen 'Uncaught Error' overlay in dev. Reproduction: open Angel Mode → click angel-jarvis (routes to /jarvis) → click jv-back (unmounts Angel Mode wrapper) → red screen. Fix: wrap the call as Promise.resolve(recorder.stop()).catch(() => {}) so both sync throws (try/catch) and async rejections (.catch) are swallowed on best-effort cleanup. Post-fix verification: 0 pageerrors, home screen renders cleanly, /jarvis reachable via angel-jarvis, exit clean.
